result.title: Evolving Semantic Indexes for Generative Retrieval
result.summary: Generative retrieval (GR) casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs). SID design largely determines GR quality, but its discrete, interdependent components (SID construction, collision handling, decoding, and training) cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. We introduce a framework that improves these components through LLM-driven evolutionary program search, to our knowledge the first application of this approach to GR. A locally served, open-weight 31B model mutates executable GR components, so no proprietary LLM API is used, and a 1M-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1B target generator. Across 21 SID programs on NQ320K, proxy and target Recall@100 show strong rank correlation (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$). Guided by this proxy, evolution improves the seed GR on NQ320K, MSMARCO300K, and a multilingual e-commerce dataset under a fixed training recipe. On NQ320K, jointly evolving SID construction and collision handling improves Recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and Recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. A component study shows that proxy reliability depends on what is evolved: improvements transfer reliably for the semantic index but not for the generator's training objective or the full pipeline. LLM-driven evolutionary search is thus a practical tool for GR design, provided proxy reliability is established for the chosen search space.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用本地开放权重 31B 模型驱动进化式程序搜索，自动改进生成式检索中的语义 ID 构建、冲突处理、解码与训练等组件，并用百万参数代理解码器替代反复训练目标生成器提供快速反馈，在多个数据集上验证代理与目标 Recall@100 排名高度相关。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中的离散语义 ID 设计、冲突处理与解码可能与 LVR 的 latent token 化与状态表示构造有相通线索，且「代理模型筛选候选是否可靠」这一问题可供核查 LVR 中用廉价代理评估推理轨迹或监督设计的可行性。
